name: Paranoidal-NAN-E
title: Paranoidal NAN-E
author: FactorioParanoidal; Informatron by Earendel
description: NAN-E, the nanny robot of the Axiom-6 care center, rebuilt from Informatron: a companion who follows you, jokes, lectures you on technical debt and now and then drives round the base on her own errands. Her memory is wiped: recover it from memory cards found in wrecks and ruins and solve case №A113-6, what really happened to the Axiom-6. Her own research branch gives her a lamp, a paint trail home, a vacuum, an umbrella against lightning and a defibrillator that stuns attackers. Her window (Alt+N) holds her memory, the case board, a live summary of your base and help on the build.
